StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we’re here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.
  
  
StubHub connects fans with live experiences around the world. Sellers make those experiences possible—from fans selling a spare ticket to professional sellers managing large inventories. We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help make selling on StubHub simple, transparent, and dependable.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Seller Experience team builds products that give sellers confidence at every step of their journey. We want sellers to understand where things stand, know what to expect, and feel supported when something needs attention.
  
  
For a seller, a great experience means clear information about their sales, payments, timely updates without having to ask, and straightforward ways to take action.
  
  
We bring together experiences across the marketplace to make selling feel connected and intuitive. Our mission is to earn sellers’ trust through transparent information, reliable experiences, and tools that help them stay in control—so they choose to sell with StubHub again.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an
**Software Engineer II**
on Seller Experience, you’ll build customer-facing features and the services behind them. You’ll translate complex processes into experiences that are easy to understand and use, working closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across StubHub.
  
  
You’ll own scoped features from technical design through production, make thoughtful engineering decisions, and help ensure that what sellers see accurately reflects what’s happening. This role is a fit for an engineer who cares about both system reliability and the experience of the person using the product.
  
  
*Location: Hybrid (3 days in office/2 days remote) – Aliso Viejo, CA*
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, test, and launch features that make selling more intuitive, transparent, and reliable.
* Turn complex information and workflows into clear status updates, useful explanations, and simple next steps.
* Build experiences that help sellers understand payments and charges, easily submit and track disputes, and resolve common issues through self-service.
* Develop APIs and services that deliver accurate, consistent information across seller touchpoints.
* Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to understand seller needs, clarify requirements, and evaluate technical tradeoffs.
* Own the delivery of scoped features, communicate progress and dependencies, and follow through on production quality.
* Improve reliability through automated testing, monitoring, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions, share knowledge, and incorporate feedback.

**What You've Done**

* 3+ years of professional software development experience.
* Experience building and maintaining production software using a language such as C# or Java.
* Experience developing APIs and working with databases, service integrations, and distributed systems.
* Delivered features from requirements and technical design through testing, deployment, and production support.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, including investigating issues across systems and handling failure scenarios.
* Written maintainable code and meaningful automated tests, with attention to correctness, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborated effectively with engineering and product partners to deliver customer-focused solutions.

**Experience That Would Be Helpful**

* Building customer-facing web applications with a modern JavaScript or TypeScript framework.
* Developing products that simplify complex processes or help customers make informed decisions.
* Building asynchronous workflows and maintaining consistent information across multiple systems.
* Using customer feedback and product data to improve usability and reliability.

**What We Offer**

* Accelerated Growth Environment: An environment designed for swift skill and knowledge enhancement, where you have the autonomy to lead experiments and tests on a massive scale.
* Top Tier Compensation Package: Competitive base, equity, and upside that tracks with your impact.
* Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited Flex Time Off, giving you the flexibility to manage your schedule and take time to recharge as needed.
* Comprehensive Benefits Package: Prioritize your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package, featuring 401k, and premium Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance options.

**Why This Team**
Small moments shape a seller’s trust: an update that arrives at the right time, an explanation that makes sense, or an issue resolved without repeated follow-ups. You’ll build experiences that make those moments dependable, helping sellers feel informed, supported, and confident in choosing StubHub.

We are building the future of enterprise AI.
  
  
Location: Canada (Remote/Hybrid), open to US
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a highly technical, customer-facing engineering role that sits at the intersection of complex software development and strategic client architecture. FDEs work directly with prospective and existing enterprise clients to understand their architectural challenges, rapidly build high-impact proofs-of-concept (PoCs), and embed within client engineering environments to deploy production-grade code.
  
  
This role balances technical execution with strategic consulting, shifting from early-stage architecture discovery to hands-on software delivery and integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Discovery & Rapid Prototyping: Partner with sales and solutions teams during early-stage discovery to analyze a client's existing technical stack, data pipelines, and infrastructure. Rapidly construct working prototypes, mock integrations, and core code patterns to demonstrate technical feasibility and value.
  
  
Hands-on Client Deployment: Embed directly with client engineering teams to transition a proposed architecture into a live production environment. Write robust, clean, and maintainable code to build out core platforms, data pipelines, or automated frameworks.
  
  
Integration & Systems Engineering: Tackle complex systems integration challenges, working with diverse environments, cloud providers, and emerging automated frameworks to bridge gaps between disparate client architectures.
  
  
Technical Onboarding & Hand-off: Deliver production-ready codebases with exceptional documentation and architectural guardrails. Partner with internal long-term product delivery teams to ensure a seamless technical hand-off, mentoring core engineers on the specific patterns and environments established during the deployment phase.
  
  
**Core Qualifications**
Senior/Staff-Level Engineering Background: Extensive hands-on experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or data engineering, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade systems.
  
  
Polyglot & Systems Fluency: Mastery of modern backend environments (such as Python), environment configuration management, and complex API/system integration patterns.
  
  
Cloud Architecture: Deep engineering competence with at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  
  
Consultative Problem Solving: Strong communication skills with the ability to sit shoulder-to-shoulder with a client’s engineering leadership, understand ambiguous requirements, and quickly translate them into an execution plan.
  
  
Execution Speed: Ability to land in an unfamiliar codebase or architecture and confidently begin committing clean code and resolving technical hurdles on day one.
